description.value: App-based ride-hailing from Black Top & Checker Cabs (iOS/Android), using licensed taxi vehicles and professional Class 4 drivers. Fixed fares locked at booking with no surge pricing. Launched June 2026 with an initial focus on the City of Vancouver and trips to/from Vancouver International Airport (YVR); the app works across Metro Vancouver, but wait times and fares for suburban long-distance trips are currently high until more fleet joins. Holds Passenger Transportation Board TNS authorization for Region 1 (Metro Vancouver, Fraser Valley, and the Sea-to-Sky corridor to Squamish, Whistler, and Pemberton). A four-seat or six-seat van option carries oversized items such as a bike; an extra $15 charge applies to the four-seat van if the trip's purpose is to move cargo. Rides can be pre-booked up to three weeks in advance. Wheelchair-accessible vehicles available.

Interior transport.detail: Four-seat or six-seat van with luggage space for a bike; +$15 on the four-seat van if booked to move cargo

Advance booking required.detail: On-demand; can also pre-book up to 3 weeks ahead
